headline: How AI‑Driven Falcon Demand and M&A Ambitions Could Reshape CrowdStrike Holdings’ (CRWD) Investment Narrative
summary: CrowdStrike Holdings recently reported fiscal Q1 2027 revenue of US$1.39 billion and ending annual recurring revenue of US$5.51 billion, while attracting growing institutional interest and highlighting plans to use stock and debt for acquisitions in AI-focused cybersecurity.
